$comment: BIR Form 2307, January 2018 (ENCS), page 1 — the structural inventory of the
official form, authored from the inventory supplied in W2 pass 2 (read cell by
cell from the BIR's own workbook by the technical partner).
THIS FILE IS THE REFERENCE. track-b-Form2307.test.tsx reads its expectations
from here and nowhere else. Sentire's Form2307.tsx is a starting point for the
atoms, not a source of truth for what the form contains.
The workbook itself was NOT attached to the session, so it is not committed
beside this file. When it arrives it lands here as
bir-2307-jan-2018-encs.xlsx and becomes the reference of record.
